shared_constraints: Minecraft-like readable block construction rather than browser-MMO ornament
restrained charcoal, iron-gray and warm amber palette
orthogonal geometry, no text, no logos, no complete HUD
isolated green-key sources for transparent components

assets.prompt_summary: One empty square pixel-art shop panel seed, recessed charcoal center, segmented iron border and four small amber rivets, isolated on uniform bright-green chroma background; no slots, icons or text.
One empty horizontal pixel-art title plaque, dark iron and subdued brass, symmetric tileable edges, isolated on uniform bright-green chroma background; no lettering or emblem.
Four vertically stacked empty pixel-art button states with identical geometry: normal, amber hover/focus, pressed, disabled; isolated on uniform bright-green chroma background; no text or icons.

note: Only panel, plaque and button masters belong to this pipeline. Product-card states are derived from the project's existing inventory-slot textures. Background and Xiaocong reuse existing project assets and are neither generated nor copied here. asset_build_manifest.json records deterministic outputs.
